units.source_text: 我这‘远浦渔樵’的生涯，真非始料所及也。”

en.t: This life of mine, fishing and gathering firewood on a distant shore, was truly something I never expected.

units.source_text: 从前菅公经行此地，亦曾赋诗赠与驿长。

en.t: Long ago, Lord Sugawara passed through this place too, and once composed a poem to give to the station master.

units.source_text: 驿长尚如此伤离，何况这情人五节小姐，

en.t: If even the station master grieved so deeply over parting, how much more must this beloved Lady Gosechi have felt it,

units.source_text: 她竟想一人独留在须磨呢。

en.t: for she actually thought of staying behind alone in Suma.
